defect: AU2 G18 and MB1: the window inspector of a picked proposal had no way to the batch where its one officer confirmation is made; no read the Studio makes carried the case holding a proposal's package.

decisions.D1: AreaWindowFeatureSchema gains caseId (uuid, optional). The proposed CTE of area-display-window.ts already joins import_packages p for each paired package and feature, so it selects p.case_id there; the window's proposal branch passes it on and the recorded branch gives NULL::uuid. windowFeature omits caseId when the row's case_id is null. One CTE serves both proposal paths (the draft outline from the row and the body of an older draft), so both carry the case. No extra query per feature, no new index, no schema step; areas.ts and area-display-proposals.ts needed no change.
decisions.D2: WindowedInspector of a proposal shows 'Proposed in a batch, not yet confirmed.' and, only when caseId is present, a Link 'Open batch to confirm' to /studio/work/cases/<caseId>/intake. No caseId gives the line without a link. Recorded buildings keep the same markup as before.
decisions.D3: The viewFootprint doc comment in packages/scene/src/engine.ts is rewrapped to 120 characters, words unchanged; nothing else in that file.
decisions.D4: Batch page, card wording, recorded-building reads and the canonical read are not touched.
